title: Scene history
hint: A version is saved automatically each time you press Generate with changed settings. Click one to load it into this scene.
selectTitle: Selection mode: click toggles selection (Ctrl/Shift-click always works)
thumbTitle: Thumbnail size (or Shift + mouse wheel over the versions)
maxTitle: Maximum saved versions. Least recently used versions without Keep are removed first.
keptTitle: Kept: never removed automatically (click to release)
